overview_description.description: flowscope is an AI-native consulting and technology company that focuses on process mining and agentic automation for corporate operations. It provides AI agents that shadow employees, capture workflow events, and build detailed maps of how business processes run across existing systems. Using this observation, flowscope identifies bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and repetitive work, then deploys agents that execute those tasks end to end on top of current applications. Its platform includes a Chrome extension, desktop agents, APIs, and dashboards used to trace activity and monitor automation performance. flowscope works with small, medium, and scaling organizations that want production-grade automation without building an in-house AI team. The company also offers ongoing maintenance and improvement of deployed agents so they can adapt as business requirements change.
